boxes.meaning: Mr, sir, polite word for a man

english.note: This is the all-purpose polite address for an adult man, especially in service or formal situations.
Use this for a polite form of address or when referring respectfully to a particular man.

examples.english: Sir, please sign for this document.
examples.traditional: 先生，麻煩你簽收呢份文件。
examples.jyutping: sin1 saang1 maa4 faan4 nei5 cim1 sau1 ni1 fan6 man4 gin6

examples.english: The gentleman at the counter paid my bill.
examples.traditional: 櫃檯嗰位先生幫我埋咗單。
examples.jyutping: gwai6 toi4 go2 wai2 sin1 saang1 bong1 ngo5 maai4 zo2 daan1

english.note: A speaker picks this polite form especially when referring to their own husband.

examples.english: My husband will come and sign in person tomorrow.
examples.traditional: 我先生聽日會親自嚟簽名。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 sin1 saang1 ting1 jat6 wui5 can1 zi6 lai4 cim1 ming4

english.note: Use this mainly as a respectful or traditional form of address for a male teacher, rather than the default word.

examples.english: Teacher, could I ask one more time?
examples.traditional: 先生，我可唔可以問多次呀？
examples.jyutping: sin1 saang1 ngo5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 man6 do1 ci3 aa3
